ops.sql: SELECT Connector_ID, SeqNo, Stereotype, Direction, PDATA1, PDATA2, PDATA3, PDATA4, PDATA5, SubType, StyleEx, Btm_Mid_Label, Top_Mid_Label, Top_Start_Label FROM t_connector WHERE Connector_ID IN (5112, 5113)
SELECT XrefID, Name, Type, Behavior, Description, Client FROM t_xref WHERE Client IN (SELECT ea_guid FROM t_connector WHERE Connector_ID IN (5110, 5111, 5112, 5113))
